rules.//: Realtime Database security rules for the multiplayer lobby, match data and the shared card library.
rules.//2: APPLY THESE in the Firebase console: Realtime Database -> Rules -> paste -> Publish.
rules.//3: Or with the Firebase CLI: firebase deploy --only database.
rules.//4: Without these, authenticated writes to /matches, /lobbies and /cards return PERMISSION_DENIED.
rules.//cards: Shared card library. Readable by anyone so the pool loads before sign-in completes; writable by signed-in users only.
rules.//cardIndex: Per-card { updatedAt } so clients only download artwork that actually changed. A deleted card keeps an entry here marked { deleted: true } - that tombstone is what stops it reappearing from data/cards/custom-project-cards.json, which is reloaded on every visit. Deliberately no .validate here, so tombstones work under these rules with no extra setup.
